item.title: Fully Funded Masters Scholarship in Computer Science for African Students 2026
item.description: Applications are open for a fully funded master's scholarship in Computer Science at Example University. Open to African nationals including Ghana. Covers tuition fees, flights and a living allowance. A second class lower (2:2) degree is accepted. Deadline: 30 September 2026.

Clean Air Fellowship for Young African Leaders — Fully Funded
item.description: A fully funded fellowship on air quality monitoring and clean air technology for African applicants. Travel, accommodation and stipend covered. Applications close 2026-10-15.
